mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE status='PENDING' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE status=#{status} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHED', published_time=NOW(), last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE outbox_event SET status=#{status}, retry_count=retry_count+1, next_retry_time=#{nextRetryTime}, last_error=#{lastError} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PENDING', retry_count=0, next_retry_time=NULL, last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DEAD'
